_about: Chip floorplan of dbs_afe_top. GENERATED by AFE/layout/scripts/floorplan.py build from "params"; do not edit by hand (floorplan.py check fails if you do). Change a parameter with:  python3 AFE/layout/scripts/floorplan.py build --set key=value.  Units um, origin = SW corner of the outline. Explanations: AFE/layout/SPEC.md.

params.pin_source: DEFAULT (no organizer DEF yet): positions chosen by LP so that no pin wire crosses another; replace with `floorplan.py build --pins-def <organizer.def>` when the DEF arrives

zones.name: ring_w
zones.what: pin ring west: the 21 digital / pad-control pin wires straight to the macro, VDD / VSS entry = star point of the three straps, west decap bank (ADC-main)
zones.layers: pins Metal3; trunks Metal4/Metal5; decap comp/poly/Metal1

zones.name: ring_e
zones.what: pin ring east: REF entry, bias trunk between the two bias corridors

zones.name: ring_n
zones.what: pin ring north: E / IPG / REC pin escape of channels 0-1 (and any pin the organizer DEF puts here)
zones.layers: analog tracks Metal4/Metal5, digital only in the outer 12 um on Metal2/Metal3

zones.name: ring_s
zones.what: pin ring south: E / IPG pin escape of channels 2-3

zones.name: bias_corr_n
zones.what: bias corridor north: vbn vcm vg1 vcmo vg2 vrs + REF (daisy chain from bias_genc, east to west) under the analog vdd / vss strap
zones.layers: lines Metal2/Metal3 (1 um wide, 1 um apart, vss between); strap Metal4 (vss) / Metal5 (vdd)

zones.name: bias_corr_s
zones.what: bias corridor south (channels 2-3), same as north

zones.name: spare_ne
zones.what: east of the north channel row: not assigned (REF / bias trunk widening, decap or wiring for L3a)

zones.name: spare_se
zones.what: east of the south channel row: not assigned (as spare_ne)

zones.name: strap_corr_n
zones.what: strap corridor north: ADC-main strap (VDD), ADC-DAC strap (vdd_dac), vss; DAC-strap decap row; macro <-> adc_ch control wires cross it
zones.layers: straps Metal5 over vss Metal4; decap comp/poly/Metal1; crossings Metal2; rm3 strap resistor Metal3

zones.name: strap_corr_s
zones.what: strap corridor south, same as north (no strap resistor)

afe_dig.what: digital macro (LibreLane): dbs_ctrl #(N = 4) + adc_top #(N = 4) + 15 pad-control tie cells; real 4-channel logic and the 80-SCLK frame, no tied-off channels (Decisions 52, 54)
afe_dig.guard: P+ substrate ring on vss and N-well ring on VDD around the macro, inside the strap corridors (2 um each); >= 20 um to any analog device

afe_ch.what: one channel slot = control corridor | amp_ch + adc_ch + TGATE zone | analog spur corridor
afe_ch.note: slot coordinates are those of a NORTH-row channel: y = 0 is the ADC end (next to the strap corridor), y = h the amplifier end. South-row channels are the same cell mirrored about the x axis (MX).

adc_ch.what: ADC analog part (L1a): dac_sw + cmp_p + vhalf + vrefs + INV

amp_ch.rotation: the cell may be placed R0 or R90 (all 4 channels the same way) if its W x H fits only one way

bias_genc.what: shared bias (L3a): beta multiplier, start-up, ladders A / B in ppolyf_u_1k, reset-level replica, C_VRS
bias_genc.pins_side: E (towards the east ring): vbn vcm_in vg1 vcm_out vg2 vrs; vdd vss

straps.name: analog
straps.feeds: bias_genc, 4 x amp_ch.vdd, 4 x adc_ch.vdd (vhalf, Cref switch, samb inverter, sampling-TG wells), TGATE wells
straps.route: star point -> west ring -> both bias corridors (Metal5 over vss Metal4) -> spur corridor of each channel -> adc_ch.vdd

straps.name: ADC-main
straps.route: star point -> both strap corridors (Metal5, 8 um, over vss Metal4)
straps.decap: 74 units = 117.9 pF: west ring bank 38 + under each Cref 4 x 4 + under the Cin pieces 4 x 4 + corridor west ends 2 x 2

straps.name: ADC-DAC
straps.route: star point -> strap resistor rm3 2 x 222.2 um (10.0 ohm typ) in the north strap corridor -> both strap corridors (Metal5, 5 um)
straps.decap: 30 units = 47.8 pF: one row of 15 units in each strap corridor, under the straps

supply.reserve: Decision 46c lever (proved on test cell lp_cin_decap): up to 16 more units per channel under the four Cin pieces (top-level overlap, Metal3 shield on vss), on the ADC-main strap through the spur corridor

area.estimates_source: AFE/review/sim/f1_area.log: afe_chc 49,312 + fs_oneshot_c 2,314 = 51,626 um2 (amp_ch); ADC analog part 14,911; bias_genc 9,966; digital cells of the N = 8 logic 31,872 + dbs_ctrl 1,789 = 33,661, REPLACED by the AS-BUILT 4-channel macro of REVIEW R14 (AFE/dig/reports/flow_summary.rpt: 855 std cells = 18,879 um2); 2 TGATE + OR2 + INV 199; decap 0.225 nF = 56,533 um2 of gate (all ESTIMATE, the layout model is at the top of that log)
area.statement: slot / estimate - 1 (the estimates already contain block factors 1.5 / 2.5 on transistor groups and MIM spacing). Decap needs NO area of its own in this plan (strap corridors, west ring, under Cref, under Cin); the top-level factor that the outline allows on the F1 block sum without decap (618,660 um2 for 8 channels; scaled by 4 / 8 for 4 channels, ESTIMATE) is 2.17

rules.keepout_digital_nets: SCLK CS DIN DOUT cmp_clk dac_gp* dac_gn* dac_gdn rst_sw tg_on (and every net inside afe_dig)
rules.keepout_digital_nodes: summing nodes vn / vp / vn2, pseudo-resistor nodes, rec, the Cref node vref, the DAC top plates t and m
rules.keepout_exception: the last <= 10 um of a control net at the device it drives; the quasi-static nets sw_rec sw_rec_b sw_ipg sw_ipg_b rst_amp fs (they move only at a mode change)
rules.no_routing_over_cells: the top level routes only in the ring, the corridors and the two side corridors of each channel slot; nothing crosses amp_ch or adc_ch
rules.mim: MIMTM.10 no Via3 on a bottom plate; MIMTM.11 at most 10,000 um2 of MIM on one Metal4 polygon (REF, rec leave the plates through Via4 / Metal5)
rules.tgate: every TGATE instance has one gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0__filltie abutted (test cell lp_tgate_tap)
